own_candidate.causal_timestamp_law: Use only observations with authentic availability <= entry timestamp; completed intervals only; effective metadata known by entry

coherent_context_and_cohort.context_policy: Every broker native context evaluated as its own structural cohort; no support or activity ranking
coherent_context_and_cohort.membership_rule: All eligible identities in a context; authoritative linkage required for basket, peer or contract relations; no name-only linkage

compact_horizon_family.prospective_rationale: One authentic M5 update and one full hour for immediate versus hourly propagation; paired planned family, no best-horizon choice

own_candidate.compute_geometry: One causal streaming feature pass per identity plus cohort reductions; finite feature families, no parameter search or automatic mechanism optimization
own_candidate.confirmation_path: Development and selection payment followed by genuinely disjoint confirmation; existing development data cannot certify confirmation
own_candidate.dependence_unit: Shared calendar-time blocks with within-context and cross-context simultaneous dependence; identities are not independent trials
own_candidate.execution_information_path: Current EUR200 structural eligibility only; side-aware historical spread and slippage remain unknown and require later authentic certification
own_candidate.incremental_information_claim: Additional conditional information beyond the declared own-information baseline; no historical effect asserted
own_candidate.materially_distinct_causal_mechanism: Contemporaneous within-cohort price-location dispersion conditions next-hour peer adjustment
own_candidate.missingness_law: Exclude incompletely observed feature or response windows; retain masks and reasons; no imputation, no missingness-as-null
own_candidate.observable_inputs: Completed canonical M5 OHLC; independently authenticated point in time modality required
own_candidate.own_information_baseline: Own last completed M5 and hourly price location, range and broker activity, with causal clock controls; incremental predictor excluded from baseline
own_candidate.response_function: Future closed-bar log price displacement at each declared horizon, conditionally incremental to own baseline; financing or term candidates additionally require authenticated cashflow or term response. Definition only: no values calculated
own_candidate.synchronization_requirement: Exact authentic common timestamps for related identities; no forward-filled prices; own interval requires all twelve M5 observations
own_candidate.why_information_exists_before_entry: Completed observations and effective metadata precede entry; no response data used to construct features

own_capability_facts.accepted_repository_metadata_sufficient: Roster certifies all 1575 eligible identities and 29 context labels only; this closes roster membership, not a peer economic/exclusion law
own_capability_facts.exact_required_contract: Coherent eligible within-context peer domain, causal common M5 readset and exact dispersion/reduction and own-leg treatment
own_capability_facts.minimum_next_information_needed: Prospective exact dispersion/peer contract; then authentic joint feature/response support mask. No new broker contact needed to restate accepted roster membership
own_capability_facts.official_route: ProtoOAGetTrendbarsReq/Res plus accepted roster/context identities; no extra peer-link schema for this candidate
semantic_fields_still_unspecified: own-leg inclusion and peer response aggregation

own_feature_authority.L_j: Exact hourly price location coordinate of immutable B_j(t)
own_feature_authority.availability: Every peer required at feature entry has completed immutable B and certified availability<=t; no forward fill
own_feature_authority.cohort_authority: Frozen accepted 1575 eligible study identities grouped by BROKER_NATIVE_CONTEXT; immutable study cohort, no claim of dynamic historical economic linkage
own_feature_authority.fresh_peer_set: P_i(t)={j in same frozen context,j!=i, immutable B_j(t) available causally}. Freeze this set at feature timestamp t; never add response-selected identities.
own_feature_authority.mechanism: Contemporaneous within-cohort price-location dispersion conditions next-hour peer adjustment
own_feature_authority.missingness: Own B/feature and own future response valid, |P_i(t)|>=2 and |P_i,h^R|>=2. No filling/imputation, no substitutions outside frozen P_i(t). Retain peer set sizes and missingness reasons.
own_feature_authority.nonredundancy_domain_law: Hold own B fixed; vary legal fresh peer hourly locations in same study context to vary Phi. Only structural nonredundancy, no predictive claim
own_feature_authority.response_role: Own relative-to-contemporaneous-peer adjustment, as explicit new user authority
own_feature_authority.valid_response_peer_set: P_i,h^R subset of frozen P_i(t): complete h-bar future window with valid finite OHLC and positive close endpoints. Invalid responses are missing, never zero.

proof.legal_bar_realization: Peer bars have LOW=1,HIGH=3; last completed-hour CLOSE=1/3/2 respectively realizes locations 0/1/1/2; own bars remain unchanged. Availability is synthetic and completed.
